title: Dóru app settings

$schema.description: Reference to the settings schema; enables autocompletion and validation in editors that understand JSON Schema.

provider.description: Provider preset id. "acp" spawns an Agent Client Protocol agent (see "command") instead of calling an HTTP API.

baseUrl.description: API base URL. Empty means the preset's default endpoint. Ignored for provider "acp".

model.description: Model name. Empty means the preset's first default model. The DORU_AI_MODEL environment variable overrides this value. Ignored for provider "acp".

reasoning.description: Reasoning level for models that support it, translated to each provider's native mechanism. Absent means the provider default.

apiKey.description: API key in plaintext. On first load the app encrypts it with the OS keychain, moves it to "apiKeyEncrypted" and removes this field. The DORU_AI_API_KEY environment variable overrides any stored key.

apiKeyEncrypted.description: API key encrypted with the OS keychain (safeStorage), base64-encoded. Written by the app; do not edit by hand.

command.description: For provider "acp" only: the agent binary to spawn.

args.description: For provider "acp" only: arguments for the agent command.

ai.description: AI provider settings for the agent chat.

command.description: Executable to run (npx, a binary path, …).

env.description: Extra environment variables, e.g. API keys the server needs.

mcp.description: Optional external MCP servers whose tools the in-app agent can use (web search, FamilySearch, filesystem, …). Each server is spawned as a subprocess; tools are prefixed with the server name, e.g. "web:search".

theme.description: Theme id: the file name (without the .json extension) of a bundled theme or of a file in <userData>/themes. Defaults to "doru". The operating system appearance decides which palette applies.

description: Settings for the Dóru desktop app (settings.json in the app's data directory). The file is JSONC — comments are allowed and changes are picked up live while the app is running. Defaults live in the app; the file only records explicit overrides, which the app writes when settings change.
